text: Given the thickened endometrial stripe and postmenopausal bleeding, I must rule out endometrial pathology despite the normal CA-125. REQUEST TEST: Endometrial Biopsy

text: The CT scan shows no metastatic spread, but the adnexal mass requires further characterization to determine if it is synchronous ovarian cancer or a benign lesion. REQUEST IMAGES
